issues.issue: Confirmed printed error, not a misread: line 16 Total Resources Available 442,940 is only receipts (413,180 + 29,760) and leaves out the line 5 beginning balance 199,426, and line 26 66,335 = 442,940 - 376,605 follows from that wrong line 16. The real ending balance is unclear: the roll-forward gives 265,761, cash + CDs on lines 28-29 add to 239,977 (25,784 apart), and line 26/31 print 66,335. business_type.ending is recorded as 66,335. A person should decide which ending balance to use (or check with the district); decision_needed[] is missing.

Mixed line (reimbursements, interest, other). Under the mixed-line rule it should get its dominant category plus review, but the page doesn't show which part is dominant, so 'other' with review is defensible.

Irrigation district. The disbursement rules list water and drainage districts under 'natural resources/conservation', which may fit better than 'utilities'. entity_type 'public power / utility' (and treating the whole entity as business-type) is also a judgment call; 'other' may fit better.

issues.on_page: Personal and Real Property Taxes -- water taxes 413,180
issues.issue: Irrigation district 'water taxes' are usually per-acre assessments on irrigated land, so 'special assessments' could apply. The form prints the line as property taxes, so 'property tax' is defensible.
